title: Goaria language - Wikipedia
text: Goaria is a Marwari language of the Rajasthani branch of Indo-Aryan languages, spoken by approximately 25,000 people in Sindh Province, Pakistan. [2] The Goaria people are predominantly Hindu and use Hindi for religious worship.

title: Goaria language — Grokipedia
text: Goaria is a stable indigenous language of the Indo-European family spoken in Pakistan by the Goaria ethnic community, where it serves as the primary first language (L1) for all members and is the norm in home and community settings.
